transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Thor! I’ve been gone for three weeks negotiating with the Dark Elves on YOUR father’s orders, and I return to THIS?! My rune-map — the one I spent months crafting — is soaked through with mead! There are scorch marks on the ceiling! You said you would keep the hall in order while I was away!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text:
Ah, Loki, welcome back to Asgard. I see you have noticed the changes in our shared quarters. It seems a mighty storm of mead and thunder passed through in your absence. Fear not, brother, for I shall explain the series of events that led to this chaotic scene.

You see, while you were away on your diplomatic mission, I engaged in a fierce battle with the Giants of Jotunheim. They dared to challenge the might of Mjölnir, and I had no choice but to defend our realm with thunderous fury. In the heat of battle, mead barrels were overturned, armor was shed in haste, and lightning danced across the skies, leaving its mark on our humble abode.

As for your rune-map, I must offer my sincerest apologies. It seems that in the midst of the chaos, it became collateral damage in our clash with the Giants. Rest assured, I shall assist you in restoring and recreating your intricate work, for I value your craftsmanship and dedication to the art of runic magic.

I understand your frustration, Loki, and I take full responsibility for the disorder that has befallen our hall. Let us work together to clean up this mess and restore order to our shared space. And perhaps, once the dust settles, we can share tales of our adventures over a feast fit for the halls of Valhalla.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Thor, your tales of valor do little to mend the disarray you've left behind! Having the audacity to call this chaos just "changes" — as if it's merely redecorating!
